en: The image is a vintage, black-and-white postcard illustration depicting an ornate neoclassical building with a domed roof, columns, and detailed architectural features. The scene includes horse-drawn carriages, early automobiles, and people dressed in early 20th-century attire, suggesting a popular public venue. The background is filled with trees, and the building is lively with visitors. The bottom of the postcard has printed text.
